vantage.screen.title: Vantage Settings
vantage.search.hint: Search items by name or id...
vantage.item_scales.empty: No items scaled yet. Type above to find one.
vantage.item_scales.disabled: Item scaling is off - these values are not applied.
vantage.option.fullbright.tooltip: Lights the world with a fixed brightness instead of your video setting.
vantage.option.gamma_multiplier.tooltip: Brightness used while Fullbright is on. 1 matches the vanilla maximum; higher goes past it.
vantage.option.disable_sky_fog.tooltip: Fog blended into the sky and clouds.
vantage.option.disable_terrain_fog.toolt: Distance haze over the ground, including the fade at your render distance.
vantage.option.disable_thick_fog.tooltip: The dense fog the Wither and the Ender Dragon create.
vantage.option.disable_pumpkin_blur.tool: Hides any helmet camera overlay, which in vanilla is the carved pumpkin.
vantage.option.fire_offset.tooltip: Moves the first-person flames down so they cover less of the screen.
vantage.option.shield_offset.tooltip: Moves the held shield down and out of your line of sight.
vantage.option.visual_barriers.tooltip: Shows barrier blocks without needing one in hand.
vantage.option.item_scale_first_person.t: Applies your per-item scales to the item in your hand.
vantage.option.item_scale_dropped.toolti: Applies your per-item scales to items lying on the ground, so drops are easier to spot.
vantage.option.armor_hud.tooltip: Shows each worn armour piece with its remaining durability, which the vanilla armour bar does not.
vantage.option.armor_hud_anchor.tooltip: Hotbar tucks the widget against the hotbar itself; the corners place it freely.
vantage.option.armor_hud_side.tooltip: Which end of the hotbar the widget sits at. Only used by the Hotbar position.
vantage.option.armor_hud_visibility.tool: Whether empty armour slots leave a gap or are closed up.
vantage.option.armor_hud_offhand.tooltip: Move aside shifts the widget over while something is in your offhand, then shifts it back. Always reserve keeps the gap permanently so nothing ever moves.
vantage.option.shield_status.tooltip: Turns the held shield red while an axe hit has it disabled. No indicator while it works normally.
vantage.option.hotbar_keybinds.tooltip: Labels each hotbar slot with the key that selects it. Long key names are shortened to fit the slot.
vantage.option.no_sign_gui.tooltip: Skips the text editor when you place a sign.
vantage.option.auto_join_party.tooltip: Runs the Join command from a public party invitation on PvPClub as soon as it appears.
vantage.option.tab_heads.tooltip: Forces player faces into the tab list even on servers where vanilla hides them.
vantage.option.locator_heads.tooltip: Replaces the coloured dot on the locator bar with the player's face.
vantage.option.food_overlay.tooltip: Saturation over the hunger bar, a pulsing preview of what the food in your hand would restore, and food values on item tooltips.
vantage.option.dark_window_title_bar.too: Asks Windows for a dark window title bar instead of the light one. Windows only; ignored elsewhere.
vantage.option.armor_hud_warning.tooltip: Shakes a warning icon beside a piece that is about to break, and plays a sound when it takes another hit.
vantage.option.armor_hud_warning_percent: Warn once durability drops to this share of the maximum.
vantage.option.shulker_tooltip.tooltip: Hold the preview key (Left Alt by default) to swap the vanilla contents list for a grid.
vantage.sound_volumes.empty: No sounds turned down yet. Type above to find one.
vantage.sound_volumes.disabled: Sound volumes are off - these levels are not applied.
vantage.option.sound_volumes.tooltip: Turn individual sounds down, off, or up past normal, without touching the whole category.
vantage.option.ping_number.tooltip: Shows latency in milliseconds in the tab list instead of five bars.
vantage.option.status_effect_timer.toolt: Shows the time left on each effect and lets the whole block be moved to another corner.
vantage.option.no_explosion_particles.to: Hides the debris cloud thrown up by TNT and end crystals. The flash, sound and damage are unchanged.
Stops resource packs being marked as made for another version.
vantage.option.death_coordinates.tooltip: Shows where you died on the death screen.
vantage.option.status_effect_style.toolt: Numbers keep the exact time on each icon. The bar styles are quicker to read at a glance.
vantage.option.status_effect_scale.toolt: Sizes the icons, or the whole frame in the full bar style.
vantage.option.feature_keys.tooltip: Bind a key to any on/off setting so it can be flipped without opening the menu.
vantage.feature_keys.empty: Nothing bound yet. Type above to find a setting.
Sizes the digits in the Numbers style, or the bar in either bar style.
vantage.option.combat_hitboxes.tooltip: Outlines players only, without the debug view's clutter. The box turns red once they are within your attack range. Invisible players are left out.
vantage.option.item_scales.tooltip: Resize chosen items. Which items, and by how much, is behind the settings icon.
